context7.usage: Use it PROACTIVELY: the FIRST stop for any library/framework API question (`resolve-library-id` → `query-docs`); web search is the fallback, not the default.

JIRA_URL: Base URL of your Jira site.
Jira Server/DC: https://jira.your-company.com (then auth via JIRA_PERSONAL_TOKEN instead of USERNAME+API_TOKEN)
JIRA_USERNAME: Your Atlassian account email (Cloud API-token auth).
JIRA_API_TOKEN: example: ATATT3xFfGF0abc...  (long string; keep secret, never commit)
CONTEXT7_API_KEY: Optional — higher rate limits. Create at https://context7.com/dashboard
leave empty to run without a key
